SECTION 23 / RETAINED ADDITION
31. PKCE and OAuth State

SIMPLE ENGLISH
PKCE binds authorization code redemption to a client-generated verifier; state binds the
callback to the initiated flow. OIDC nonce binds an ID token to the flow.

request එකට සම්බන්ධ කරනවා. nonce එක OIDC ID token එකට අදාළයි.

Are state and PKCE identical? No; they serve different binding purposes.
